posts.author: M.I.A.
posts.body:
I know this doesn't directly put you in the path of resolving your inquiry, but here's what I've got for ya...
In these images, I have kept the faces that I have at some point in my 25yrs (ooof.. wow. to say it out loud.. ) of RPGMakering seen SV Battlers for.
Now granted.. back when this RTP was the thing, a lot of really.. really bad frankenspriting happened, which sometimes even included ripped material, and the SV Actor sheet templates were so choppy and silly..
Do with this information what you will. They did exist at SOME point in time.
-MIA

posts.author: HB_Games
posts.body: I'm pretty sure these are some rpg maker 2k npcs facesets. There are no battlers for them because rpg maker 2k only have frontal battles with static enemies. You won't find side battlers but I'm sure there are static battlers for some of them that were used as enemies in troops. I' not sure if they are official nor where you can find them, though
